narrative: Today's briefing highlights significant advancements in AI, particularly in virtual try-on, AI agents, and infrastructure, alongside developments in space exploration and technology policy. The increasing integration of AI across various sectors signals a transformative period for industry and daily life.

highlights.title: ChatGPT can now virtually try on clothes for you
highlights.whyItMatters: This feature enhances online shopping experiences and showcases practical AI applications in consumer retail.

highlights.title: Google thinks SpaceX’s Starship has to launch 1,600 times before space data centers get off the ground
highlights.whyItMatters: Highlights the ambitious scale and logistical challenges of establishing space-based data infrastructure, a frontier for future computing.

highlights.title: World’s first enhanced geothermal power plant completed in just 23 months
highlights.whyItMatters: Demonstrates rapid progress in sustainable energy solutions, crucial for global climate goals.

highlights.title: NASA’s SpaceX Crew-13 Launches
highlights.whyItMatters: Marks continued human spaceflight endeavors and international collaboration in scientific exploration.

highlights.title: Sony brings AI graphics upscaling to the regular PS5
highlights.whyItMatters: Indicates significant advancements in gaming technology and consumer-facing AI enhancements.

highlights.title: Cloudflare K2: serverless event streams
highlights.whyItMatters: Enhances real-time data processing capabilities for modern serverless applications.

highlights.title: Photon held a funeral for mobile apps. Now it has $4.5M to help replace them with agents.
highlights.whyItMatters: Reflects a significant shift towards AI-driven conversational agents over traditional mobile applications.

highlights.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Argon, called its most powerful model yet
highlights.whyItMatters: A major release in large language models, indicating rapid progress in AI capabilities.
